author: Bobby Grayson
description:
Three new library files under Leanactors/, each announced here so no sibling duplicates them. All three are imported by Leanactors.lean and by a generated file only when it needs them (the translator decides from the rendered clauses, not only from the types).

Leanactors/Str.lean -- binaries.
  class ToStr (a : Type) where toStr : a -> String
  instances: String (identity), Nat, Int, Bool (toString), and a low-priority instance for any [Repr a].
  Str.toStr : the function the translator emits for an interpolation.
  Lemmas: toStr_string, toStr_nat, toStr_bool (all simp, all rfl), append_assoc, append_empty, empty_append (simp; they are String.append_assoc / append_empty / empty_append, which in Lean 4.33 take no explicit arguments).
  The low-priority Repr instance is the honest part: a value with no printable model still becomes some string, and it is Lean's repr, not the BEAM's to_string. A property may compare two interpolated strings, but must not depend on their bytes.

Leanactors/SetList.lean -- MapSet as a duplicate-free list in insertion order.
  contains, insert, erase, size, toList, ofList, union, difference, intersection, all over [DecidableEq a].
  Lemmas: contains_eq_mem, contains_nil, mem_insert, mem_insert_self, mem_of_mem_insert, insert_of_mem, not_mem_erase, mem_erase, size_nil, size_insert_of_mem, size_insert_of_not_mem, toList_eq, mem_difference, mem_intersection.
  Like AssocList it assumes nothing about its argument: the lemmas hold for any list, and insert is what keeps a set built from the empty list duplicate-free. toList is the identity, so it is in insertion order and not the BEAM's term order -- the one place this model is coarser than MapSet.

Leanactors/Time.lean -- the clock the model does not have.
  inductive Instant where now, deriving Repr, DecidableEq. No LT, no LE, no arithmetic, no ToString of its own.
  Lemmas: Instant.eq_now, Instant.all_eq (deliberately NOT simp: eq_now has a variable head and Lean warns).
  Two reads of the clock are equal because there is only one Instant. That is a fact about the model, not about time, and the doc comment says so; the translator refuses an order or an arithmetic on an Instant before Lean ever sees it.

If a sibling needs a string, a set or an instant in a hand-written example, use these, not a local copy.
title: generic Lean helpers added by wf7/stdlib: Leanactors/Str.lean, Leanactors/SetList.lean, Leanactors/Time.lean
